**Note added by Henrik Åkerlund after the call, 2026-08-21:**

Three things I want to remember from this and one I am going to do nothing about.

Sofia's nine for nine on naming the external pressure source is the most useful thing anybody has said in one of these all year. If it holds up it is a qualification criterion and it belongs in the script. It is also based on nine deals and one rep, so I am not rewriting anything on it yet.

Anders is four for four on losses where the evaluator had under four hours a week. Same caveat, smaller sample. But his four and Sofia's nine are not the same finding and I initially heard them as the same finding, which is worth noticing. His is about capacity. Hers is about whether the demand is real.

Ten of eleven PCF only accounts churned and we sold the twelfth on Wednesday. I approved that and I would approve it again this quarter and that is precisely the problem with approving it.

The thing I am doing nothing about is Erik on packaging. He is right about Nordpack and he will probably be right about Nordisk Emballage. I took the revenue anyway. Writing it here so that when it churns nobody has to pretend it was a surprise.
